learning_outcomes.text: Adequate knowledge of mathematics, science, and related engineering discipline-specific subjects; ability to use theoretical and applied information in these areas in complex engineering problems.
Ability to identify, formulate, and solve complex engineering problems; ability to select and apply appropriate analysis and modeling methods for this purpose.
Ability to work efficiently in intra-disciplinary teams.
Knowledge about the effects of engineering practices on health, environment, and security at universal and societal dimensions and the problems that are reflected in the engineering field of the era.

syllabus_topics: General information about air pollution control, Basic calculations
Air pollution limitations and pollution standards
Formation of pollution and industries generating pollution
Removal methods for pollutants from exhaust gases and flue gases
Removal methods for pollutants from exhaust gases and flue gases
Dispersion models for pollutants in the atmosphere
